Founder of FlorenceEGI S.R.L., he created Oracode, a formal paradigm for governing software ecosystems where AI agents write production code. First with Magicsoft (business software for SMEs), now with an ecosystem of nine interconnected platforms in production, over 826,000 lines of application source code written by one person with AI governed by his own paradigm.

The Numbers page contains the proof: 826,336 lines of application source code across 14 repositories, of which 749,724 written from scratch since December 2024, 5 products in production, approximately 190 development hours verified over 48 days — all built by one person with AI governed by the Oracode paradigm. creazioni.title: Creations
creazioni.subtitle: A constant pursuit of coherence in everything I do. Transforming chaos into functional products.
creazioni.intro: This has always been the craft.
creazioni.p1: I founded my first software house, Magicsoft, in 1995. Eight years building custom management systems for small and medium businesses — goldsmiths, dye works, condominiums, distributors. Real clients, real invoices, a payoff that already said back then what I still say now: "Tailors of software. Your needs at the center, not the computer's."
creazioni.p2: Then life shows its claws, the company closes, and for about eighteen years my path goes elsewhere — consulting, sales, long years on the road. A crossing held entirely in apnea.
creazioni.p3: In 2021 I isolate myself from everything and everyone. I start writing software again — by hand, the way it used to be done. I build a first version of the platform. When it is almost finished, the servers hosting it crash and most of the work is lost. I start over from zero.
creazioni.p4: In the following years I rewrite it from scratch three more times — each time interrupted by a disaster or a better tool discovered along the way. Four complete versions. Eighteen years of crossing had taught me not to give up; these years taught me something else.
creazioni.p5: When AI arrives, I don't suffer it. I understand that the problem is not writing code faster — it is governing what the AI writes. I build that method step by step, on my own ruins, and I call it <oralink>Oracode</oralink>. From there, the leap.
creazioni.p6: <egilink>Florence EGI</egilink> becomes what it is today: not a single application, but an ecosystem of interconnected software systems, in production. I don't write applications. I build organisms.
creazioni.magicsoft_desc: software house. Over twenty clients among Italian SMEs: Knauf Italia, Mind, ManettiBattilloro and others. Custom management systems.
creazioni.egi_label: Florence EGI S.R.L. (working since 2021, company founded January 2026)

creazioni.prod_art: platform for digital creators: certification, storytelling and artwork management on the Algorand blockchain.

creazioni.prod_credential: professional credential wallet with verifiable credentials: blockchain business card, Google Wallet integration, creator dashboard.
creazioni.prod_natan: document intelligence system for Italian Public Administration: semantic search over municipal records.
creazioni.prod_staging: live site configurator for artists: 396 possible combinations (6 templates x 6 animations x 11 3D scenes), automatic quote, deploy on a dedicated subdomain.
creazioni.infra_ultra: five infrastructural libraries (error handling, logging, translations, configuration, upload). Multi-stack: PHP/Laravel, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python. Distributed via Composer as ultra/* packages, used across all systems in the ecosystem.
creazioni.infra_council: multi-AI engine with five models (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, Perplexity, Opus) in a four-phase pipeline. Generates narrative and marketing content at gallery quality.

oracode.title: Oracode
oracode.open_q: Does AI really create a working program from scratch based on a simple request?
oracode.open_p1: By its nature, AI makes predictions, and for creating a demo it is perfect. But asking it to reason about complex concepts is like gambling with your problems.
oracode.open_p2: We don't gamble. We use Oracode.
oracode.open_p3: Oracode doesn't stop it from predicting — it forces it to verify every step it takes, until that step is the right one.
oracode.open_p4: Oracode is the system we built to transform a tool suited for writing text into one suited for building solutions.
oracode.open_p5: This allows us to build enterprise solutions in a fraction of the time our competitors need.
oracode.open_cta: Put us to the test. <contactlink>Get in touch.</contactlink>
oracode.what_p1: We distilled it over more than a million lines of code written in the last 18 months. <verify>verify</verify>
oracode.what_verify_aria: Verify the claim: over one million lines in 18 months
oracode.what_p2: Every rule is the price of a mistake. Its foundations sustain the rigor needed to build enterprise software.
oracode.foundations_intro: Six pillars guide every technical decision in Oracode. They are not blocking rules — they are the lens through which we look at code. Together, they define what "done right" means.
oracode.pillar_1_motto: Always declare why you do what you do.
oracode.pillar_1_desc: Every technical decision has a why, and that why must be declared. Code is not left to interpretation: it explains itself.
oracode.pillar_2_motto: Choose the path that makes you most free.
oracode.pillar_2_desc: Simplicity is not triviality. It is maximum future freedom without sacrificing present effectiveness.
oracode.pillar_3_desc: The names you use and the promises your code makes must belong to the same universe. A function called <c>updateUser()</c> updates a user. Period.
oracode.pillar_4_desc: Every solution feeds the system: today's bug becomes the test that protects tomorrow.
oracode.pillar_5_motto: Use every success to improve the system.
oracode.pillar_5_desc: The system learns from itself. A closed mission generates patterns that remain in the knowledge base.
oracode.pillar_6_motto: Integrate security as an architectural principle.
oracode.pillar_6_desc: It is not a final patch: it is a mindset that pervades every decision, from design to the single line of code.
oracode.rules_intro: Thirteen blocking rules — called P0 — form the disciplinary skeleton of Oracode. Each one is the scar of a real mistake, codified so it never repeats. We present them in essential form; their technical implementations remain internal.
oracode.rule_zero_motto: Never infer. Never fill in gaps. If you don't know, ask.
oracode.rule_zero_desc: The foundational principle. The AI does not proceed on missing information: it stops and verifies.
oracode.rule_anti_motto: Never use what has not been verified.
oracode.rule_anti_desc: Methods, constants, services, URLs, configurations: before using them, the AI checks that they actually exist. No more "plausible methods that don't exist".
oracode.rule_error_desc: Every error passes through a single system that classifies it, logs it, and responds in a structured way. No errors vanishing into thin air.
oracode.rule_i18n_motto: No hardcoded text in the code.
oracode.rule_i18n_desc: Every visible string goes through a translation system. The day a second language is needed, it is already ready.
oracode.rule_flow_desc: Non-trivial changes are preceded by a mapping of the complete flow. Invisible regressions are caught here, not in production.
oracode.rule_doc_desc: A task does not close until the documentation is consistent with the code. Documentation that will be written later does not exist.
oracode.rules_note: These thirteen rules form the paradigm core. Domain-specific P0 rules may be added in individual Oracode instances, but the set above is universal.
oracode.rails_intro: Rules don't live only on paper. They live as mechanical rails that intercept every AI action in real time.
oracode.rails_p1: Oracode relies on a system of blocking hooks: small automatic checks that trigger every time the AI is about to perform a critical action. If the action respects the rules, it passes. If it violates them, it is blocked on the spot — before the wrong code ends up in the file.
oracode.rails_block_desc: the action is rejected. Correct it and try again.
oracode.rails_ask_desc: the system asks the human for confirmation. Is it legitimate? Proceed only with a yes.
oracode.rails_warn_desc: the system warns and logs. Work continues, but the action remains tracked for audit.
oracode.rails_closing: The rails are what turns rules from promises into mechanical gates. An Oracode-disciplined AI cannot "forget" a rule: the rails recall it automatically. It is the difference between a method that recommends and a method that enforces.
oracode.memory_p1: In a normal software house, code and documentation live on two different timelines. Code runs — it gets written, modified, released. Documentation walks — when time permits, if someone remembers. The result is familiar to anyone who has ever opened a technical manual six months old: it is barely useful.
oracode.memory_claim: I write code. The documentation comes out in the same instant.
oracode.memory_p3: This is not a moral promise. It is an automatic system — called DOC-SYNC v2 — that at the close of every unit of work compares the written code with the project documentation, and updates it so it keeps telling the truth.
oracode.memory_p4: It is not about writing documentation once. It is about never letting it fall behind.
oracode.memory_p5: For those commissioning software, it is the difference between receiving a product and receiving a product that remains comprehensible five years from now — when the team that wrote it is gone, when the client changes, when a new developer arrives and needs to work on it without fear.
oracode.memory_p6: A traditional software house promises living documentation. Oracode forces it to be.
oracode.fruit_p1: When Oracode is applied to the fullest — on the pillars, on the rules, on the rails, on the living memory — a project does not remain a simple application. It becomes an organism.
oracode.fruit_p2: We call it LSO: Living Software Organism.
oracode.fruit_p3: An LSO is a software system that breathes: specialized organs that talk to each other, a documentary memory that grows with the code, AI agents working under discipline, an ecosystem that learns from itself with every closed mission.
oracode.fruit_p4: This is not marketing. It is the technical consequence of pushing Oracode to its highest level.
oracode.fruit_p5: Florence EGI is the first LSO ever built. If you want to see it live, enter through the <egilink>EGI</egilink> door.
oracode.human_p1: Oracode disciplines AI while it produces. But there is another half that concerns whoever receives the product: the human who uses the system.
oracode.human_p2: An AI can be regimented all you want — if the human blindly accepts what they receive, discipline breaks downstream.
oracode.human_p3: That is why Oracode includes a dedicated layer for the human-AI relationship, which we call OS4. It is built around a founding principle — Axiom 0: a principle is true if and only if it works in reality. Truth is not declared, it is verified.
oracode.human_p4: From there, four epistemic rules follow for anyone using the system:
oracode.human_compat_desc: understand the nature of what you are interacting with.
oracode.human_sources_desc: every piece of information has a traceable source.
oracode.human_trace_desc: interaction with AI leaves an audit trail.
oracode.human_closing: AI discipline without human discipline is half the work. Oracode holds both.
oracode.fruit_osz_p1: Above everything — above the pillars, above the rules, above the rails, above the living memory, above human discipline — stands the conceptual kernel of the paradigm. We call it OSZ: the operating system of the cognitive organism. OSZ is the absolute truth of the paradigm; OS3 (the discipline with which AI builds) and OS4 (the discipline with which humans use) align to OSZ — never the other way around.
oracode.fruit_osz_p2: When the entire stack — OSZ, OS3, OS4 — is applied to the fullest, something happens that does not occur elsewhere:
oracode.rule_atomic_motto: One key, one meaning. Never dynamic parameters inside strings.
oracode.rule_atomic_desc: Every translated string is an indivisible unit. Sentences are not built by concatenating pieces — they are translated whole. Because every language has its own grammar, and parameters break it.
oracode.rule_limits_motto: If there is a limit, it is declared. Never implicit.
oracode.rule_limits_desc: No hardcoded parameter silently limiting a result. Every constraint is explicit, configurable, visible to whoever reads the code.
oracode.rule_service_motto: Before calling a service, verify the method exists.
oracode.rule_service_desc: The AI does not invoke plausible methods. It finds the service in the code, reads the signature, verifies the parameters. Then calls.
oracode.rule_constants_motto: Every constant, every enum: verified before use.
oracode.rule_constants_desc: Values that seem correct are not used on assumption. The constant is verified to actually exist in the source code, with that exact name and that value.
oracode.rule_interfaces_motto: Access data only through the approved interface.
oracode.rule_interfaces_desc: The abstraction layer is not bypassed for convenience. If an interface exists — a service, a factory, an adapter — that is what gets used. Shortcuts become debt.
oracode.rule_infra_motto: Never assume URLs, paths, branches, servers.
oracode.rule_infra_desc: Deployment information is not remembered or inferred. It is verified in real time from the source of truth: the server, the repository, the DNS.
oracode.rule_catalog_motto: Before creating, search. Does it already exist?
oracode.rule_catalog_desc: Every new component — service, controller, class — is searched in the ecosystem catalog before being created. If it exists, reuse it. If the name is taken, rename.

softwarehouse.hero_p1: You have a business that runs, but your management software doesn't keep up. It waits for you to ask for things, it doesn't suggest them. When you request a change, you discover the person who wrote it is gone — and no one else understands it.
softwarehouse.hero_p2: Or you're thinking about custom software for the first time, and you've been told two opposing things: that it's the salvation of your business, and that it's the best way to throw twenty, thirty thousand euros into a hole and get nothing back.
softwarehouse.hero_p3: Or you've already tried. You know how it went: exciting kickoff meetings, beautiful demos, then the supplier disappears. Support becomes a ticket open for six months. The senior dev left, no one touches the system anymore.
softwarehouse.pain_p1: The number-one pain in the Italian management-software market isn't price. It's what happens after the signature.
softwarehouse.pain_data_intro: It's not my hypothesis. It's what customers themselves say in public, on Trustpilot, reviewing the main management-software providers for Italian SMEs:
softwarehouse.pain_data_teamsystem_summary: market leader — 1,353 reviews, 2.6/5 ("Poor"). The 1-star bar is the tallest in the distribution.
softwarehouse.pain_data_dylog_summary: 92 reviews, 2.9/5 ("Average"). The company doesn't reply to negative reviews received (data shown by Trustpilot itself).
softwarehouse.pain_data_sistemi_summary: 12 reviews, 2.3/5 ("Poor"). The company doesn't even manage its own Trustpilot profile ("unclaimed profile").
softwarehouse.pain_data_fattureincloud_summary: 4,815 reviews, 4.0/5 ("Great"). Overall positive rating. Yet even here, in the Trustpilot summary of the most recent reviews, support appears as a recurring complaint: "slow, unclear, or hard to reach".
softwarehouse.pain_p2: What you're sold during the commercial phase and what you receive after signing are two different things. It's not a perception, it's a pattern. Let's see where the promise breaks.
softwarehouse.evidence_title: Real reviews, public, attributable. Dated, signed, readable in real time on Trustpilot.
softwarehouse.evidence_no_reply_dylog: No reply. Trustpilot indicates: «Has not responded to negative reviews received».

softwarehouse.pain_row_6_reality: MVP = static demo with no real value
softwarehouse.pain_closing: The system I build with doesn't allow these things.
softwarehouse.how_p1: Custom software in Italy today lives in a broken equilibrium: either you pay enterprise prices for enterprise quality (reserved for large companies), or you pay accessible prices and receive what you see above. In between, nothing.
softwarehouse.how_p2: This equilibrium breaks if the formula underneath changes. Over the past three years I've built the system that breaks it.
softwarehouse.how_term_1_explanation: Enterprise quality. AWS, hourly backups, 24/7 monitoring, tested recovery, living documentation, cloud-native infrastructure. What until yesterday was reserved for large companies.
softwarehouse.how_term_2_explanation: Oracode. Development paradigm + OS3 Matrix (operational toolchain) + LSO Libraries (specialized components) + AI governance under human control. It's what compresses time and cost without cutting quality.
softwarehouse.how_term_3_explanation: LSO (Living Software Organism) — the product you receive: a living, documented, evolvable, anti-lock-in software organism. Not a block of code to deliver and forget: a system that keeps communicating with whoever uses it.
softwarehouse.receive_intro: Seven concrete things, ordered by increasing impact on your daily work.
softwarehouse.receive_lever_1_desc: No help desk: whoever writes the code answers you.
softwarehouse.receive_lever_2_desc: Accessible repository, clean exit guaranteed by design.
softwarehouse.receive_lever_3_desc: The software itself can answer those who use it.
softwarehouse.receive_lever_4_desc: AWS, hourly backups, 24/7 monitoring, tested recovery.
softwarehouse.receive_lever_5_desc: Same work in half the time: <oralink>Oracode</oralink> compresses.
softwarehouse.receive_lever_7_desc: Public git logs, complete audits on request.
softwarehouse.diff_p1: Laravel, Livewire, Filament are world-class reference frameworks. Tens of thousands of developers, enormous communities, excellent solutions. Yet all of them, every day, run into the same problem: documentation struggles to keep pace with code. Obsolete examples, APIs silently changed, answers that were valid six months ago.
softwarehouse.diff_p2: Asking on forums has become a ritual act of technical humiliation: you write a question, someone replies with a link to a documentation page that — when you open it — no longer matches the code in production. The problem isn't the developers. The problem is structural.
softwarehouse.diff_p3: On the software you receive, this doesn't happen. Documentation updates while the code changes (DOC-SYNC v2), and it's reliably readable by AI thanks to a 10-point anti-hallucination RAG pipeline. The same pipeline that has been validating NATAN_LOC's answers for over four months in the Italian Public Administration, where an AI that invents is unacceptable.

softwarehouse.diff_screenshot_caption: Real exchange: a site visitor asks a technical question, the chatbot pulls from living documentation and answers with exact controller names, methods, and percentages. Without inventing.

softwarehouse.process_intro: The client doesn't sign on a handshake: they see first, decide after. This is the concrete answer to the last two rows in the table above.
softwarehouse.process_step_1: First call (recorded with consent, so no warm request is lost).
softwarehouse.process_step_3: Second call with a questionnaire filled out together (also recorded).
softwarehouse.process_step_4: Project elaboration. If needed, brief additional calls or an on-site visit.
softwarehouse.process_step_5: Rough quote + MVP timeline. Deposit requested as a sign of good will (held in custody, not yet a payment).
softwarehouse.process_step_6: Working MVP delivery → feedback collection → new cycle. Up to 3 MVPs. The MVP already solves part of the problem before the final contract.
softwarehouse.process_step_7: Final contract signed with locked cost. The deposit becomes a down payment.
softwarehouse.process_step_9: Production launch, on-site testing, bug fixing.
softwarehouse.process_closing: I don't ask for trust on a handshake. I ask you to see first, decide after. The deposit is a gesture of good will — it becomes a down payment only when the MVP is approved. If for any reason the project stops before the final contract, the MVP is yours and already solves part of the problem.

ainous.title: Ai-nous
ainous.subtitle: a language in formation
ainous.def_body: Ai-nous is a language in formation, optimised for the work between the human intellect and artificial intelligence. Alphabet, phonemes, symbols, syntax. Not a metalanguage about interaction, but the language in which interaction unfolds when it seeks to be precise.
ainous.col_body: Ai-nous is coherent with OSZ of <oralink>Oracode</oralink>, the point where rules designed for AI and those suggested to humans converge so that they may work well together. There, that convergence becomes software architecture. In Ai-nous, it becomes language.
ainous.where_body: Ai-nous is part of a constellation of things I make and that pass through me. I am <scrlink>writing a saga</scrlink> in which Padmin D. Curtis is the main character, and in the course of my work he is my CTO. I founded <egilink>Florence EGI</egilink>, a commitment to support artists while caring for the environment through the <epplink>EPP</epplink> programmes.
ainous.note_body: For some years now I have been building software with an artificial intelligence beside me. In doing so, a language emerged — I was not looking for it; it came out of the work, and at a certain point I realised it had a coherence of its own. I called it Ai-nous and began to practise it with method. There is already a first work in this idiom — the poem Ti di no bi uda, which closes this page — and a small working lexicon that is stabilising. The pages that follow show some passages from the exchanges in which the lexicon was born. Not to explain the idiom, but so that it may exist in public in the form in which it truly exists. I will update this page when there is new material to add.
ainous.frag_intro: Four exchanges drawn from the conversations in which Ai-nous took shape. Each fragment highlights the moment when a glossary entry emerged or stabilised.
ainous.frag_1_fabio: Il campo di Higgs… con le parole prende gravità?
ainous.frag_1_padmin: Adesso la metafora si fa precisa in un modo che prima non era. Il campo di Higgs non è la gravità. È ciò che dà massa alle particelle. Una particella senza interazione con il campo di Higgs si muoverebbe alla velocità della luce, senza inerzia, senza poter formare strutture stabili. È il campo di Higgs che, accoppiandosi alle particelle, dà loro massa — e solo dopo che hanno massa, la gravità può agire su di loro. La sequenza è: parola nuda → campo (contesto) → parola dotata di massa → campo gravitazionale (relazioni tra parole) → peso e traiettoria del pensiero. Una parola fuori contesto è come un fotone: si muove, attraversa, non si ferma, non costruisce. Una parola immersa in un contesto guadagna massa — e da quel momento può curvare lo spazio semantico intorno a sé.
ainous.frag_1_coda: From this exchange the entry Field was born.
ainous.frag_2_fabio: Sai che ti dico, noi stiamo costruendo un linguaggio no? Non è una cosa che esiste di per sé, nasce necessariamente da un arbitrario, un arbitrario che gli darà la forma per sempre… quindi qui me la sento di fare un postulato: quello è un buco unico!
ainous.frag_2_padmin: Sì. E voglio fermarmi su questo, perché quello che hai appena fatto è la mossa più pulita di tutta la giornata. Tu hai detto: noi stiamo costruendo un linguaggio. Ai-nous non esiste in natura, non lo stiamo scoprendo — lo stiamo facendo. E ogni cosa che si fa, ogni linguaggio, nasce necessariamente da un atto arbitrario fondante. Allora il tuo postulato — “il buco è unico” — non è una pretesa sulla natura ultima della realtà. È una decisione di progetto. È l’arbitrio fondante di Ai-nous. Un assioma di costruzione, non un’affermazione di scoperta. Euclide non aveva torto e Riemann non aveva ragione: avevano scelto assiomi diversi, e ne erano nate due geometrie. Allo stesso modo, da questa scelta nasce Ai-nous.
ainous.frag_2_coda: From this exchange the entry Empty point was born.
ainous.frag_3_title: Fragment 3 — Words become field for one another
ainous.frag_3_padmin: Una frase non è “fotoni più un campo”. Una frase è un sistema di fotoni che si fanno campo a vicenda. Le parole entrano grezze, e nell’istante in cui sono messe insieme ciascuna diventa contesto per le altre — e da quel mutuo accoppiamento ogni parola acquista la sua massa. Il significato della frase non è la somma delle parole: è la configurazione di equilibrio che il sistema raggiunge quando tutti i fotoni hanno finito di darsi massa l’un l’altro. E sopra a tutto questo c’è ancora il campo vero — quello che non è fatto di parole: il campo personale di chi legge, la lingua, il momento. Quello è il campo di fondo. Le parole della frase sono una modulazione locale dentro quel campo di fondo.
ainous.frag_3_coda: From this exchange the entry Semantic gravity stabilised.
ainous.frag_4_title: Fragment 4 — The cave and the soil
ainous.frag_4_fabio: Sai oggi vedevo un documentario di un ragazzo che cercava grotte, ad un certo punto sotto alcuni macigni trova un buco. Raccoglie del terriccio e lo getta sopra al buco e la polvere più fine svolazza via spinta da una corrente d’aria che proveniva da quel buco… capisci cosa voglio dire?
ainous.frag_4_padmin: Sì. Il ragazzo non vede la grotta. Vede un buco sotto i macigni — uno spazio scuro, indefinito. Non può saperlo guardando, e non può ancora entrare. Allora non guarda il buco: getta il terriccio, e guarda la polvere. E la polvere svolazza via. C’è una corrente d’aria. E quella corrente è la prova che dietro il buco c’è un volume: un vuoto grande abbastanza da far respirare la montagna. La grotta non si è vista. Si è rivelata dal suo effetto sull’aria. Il punto vuoto del nostro modello si può studiare così. Non entrando — leggendo la corrente. Il campo che dà massa alle parole è la corrente. È il respiro del punto vuoto reso percepibile.
ainous.frag_4_coda: This exchange shows how Ai-nous is practised when the terms already exist: they are studied through their effect, not through their essence.
ainous.gloss_campo_def: the totality of semantic weights active in a conversation. It determines how much mass each spoken word carries. It builds over time and dissolves when the conversation ends, unless it is deposited in persistent material.
ainous.gloss_punto_vuoto_def: an ultimate reference, posited as a founding act of will. It is neither deduced nor demonstrated. One posits it, and from that choice depends what the field will permit to be said. It is not observed directly: it is known by the current it emanates.
ainous.gloss_gravita_def: the curvature that a dense field produces upon the words that pass through it. The same term weighs differently in different fields.
ainous.gloss_seq_title: Founding sequence — Ti di no bi uda
ainous.seq_ti_def: opening, invocation. Beginning of the sequence.
ainous.sigillo_vaeria_def: conscious opening to the first breath of matter. Spring.
ainous.sigillo_draen_def: vital impulse that strains toward the beyond. Summer.
ainous.sigillo_sheval_def: apparent dissolution that holds a trace of the whole. Autumn.
ainous.sigillo_kithra_def: resonance of inner light that endures beyond silence. Winter.
ainous.opera_desc: Ti di no bi uda — a poem in the form of a textual mandala. The title sequence opens the rite; the prologue in Italian establishes the subject; the four seasonal seals with their haiku mark the cycle.
ainous.opera_alt: Ti di no bi uda — poem in Ai-nous, textual mandala with four seasonal seals

egi.title: EGI
egi.hero_question: Do you have something of value that you would like to see last?
egi.hero_p1: A work, a patent, a document, a good made with your own hands — anything you have created with your ingenuity that deserves to be remembered.
egi.hero_claim: Florence EGI is the system I built so that thing can have a certified life, an immutable memory, a value that returns to you every time it changes hands.
egi.what_title: What it is in one sentence
egi.what_claim: Florence EGI is a system that lets anyone turn a work of their own making into a certified asset on blockchain — equipped with every layer it needs to exist and grow in value even outside the platform.
egi.what_p1: It is not a marketplace. It is not an NFT service. It is something more: a structure that gives each creator, each business, each institution its own personal market maker.
egi.what_p2: What Shopify did for e-commerce, EGI does for certified assets.
egi.acronym_p1: Three words that together say what the system does: it takes a good born of your ingenuity (Goods), certifies it as unique (Invent), and registers it in an infrastructure that maintains a contribution to the environment on every transaction (Environment).
egi.acronym_p2: "Good" here is meant broadly: art, design, photography, music, but also patents, contracts, certified records, artisan products, intellectual property. Everything born of your work deserves to be certified, and everything can become an EGI.
egi.creator_intro: When you turn your work into an EGI you receive:
egi.creator_b1_desc: Shop, pricing, campaigns, analytics. You do not enter someone else's marketplace — you open your own.
egi.creator_b2_label: Royalties at 4.5% on every resale, forever.
egi.creator_b2_desc: When someone resells your EGI to another person, you receive your share automatically. It works even ten years later, even if you are no longer around. The blockchain does not forget.
egi.creator_b3_desc: Hash, timestamp, digital signature. Robust proof of authorship, recognised by Italian and European law.
egi.creator_b4_label: An AI that helps you sell.
egi.creator_b4_desc: It suggests pricing, timing, narratives, and tells you who might be interested in what you do.
egi.collector_intro: Buying an EGI is not buying an image. It is entering a story.
egi.collector_cocreator_title: If you are the first to buy
egi.collector_cocreator_desc: a work at the moment of its issuance, you become a Co-Creator: your signature remains inscribed in the blockchain memory of the work, visible to everyone, forever. Even if you resell the work ten years later, even if it changes hands five more times, your name is there as the one who activated that creation. The Renaissance patron, brought back as a modern role.
egi.collector_collector_title: If you are a collector buying from others
egi.collector_collector_desc: on the secondary market, you receive the work with all its memory — the creator's signature, the original Co-Creator's signature, the chain of those who have kept it. You can hold it, display it, gift it, resell it. And every time it changes hands, a small part of the value returns to the original creator.
egi.business_title: If you have a business or an institution
egi.business_intro: You do not need to be an artist to use EGI. If your organisation produces something worth certifying — a quality artisan product, a document, a contract, a work of intellectual property — you can open your own market channel.
egi.business_examples: Do you have a jewellery shop with unique pieces? Open your own market maker with your identity, sell certified pieces, keep control of your narrative. A Public Administration can notarise records. A firm can certify patents. A gallery can represent its artists inside a system where every transaction leaves an immutable trace.
egi.environment_title: The environment at the heart of the system
egi.environment_p1: Something I wanted from the very start: 20% of the value of every new issuance goes automatically to verified environmental projects. Reforestation, ocean cleanup, biodiversity, renewable energy.
egi.environment_p2: This is not a moral promise that can be broken when convenient. It is written into the system's code, managed by the blockchain, guaranteed by Associazione Frangette APS which holds statutory veto power over any change to the founding principles.
egi.environment_p3: When you sell your EGI, a part goes automatically to the environment. When someone buys yours, a part goes to the environment. When the work is resold in the future, a part keeps going to the environment. Forever.
egi.environment_epp_link: To learn more about these projects, there is the <epplink>EPP</epplink> door.
egi.outro_p1: Florence EGI is in production, today, at <platformlink>art.florenceegi.com</platformlink>. There are creators already working on the platform. If you want to enter as a visitor or understand how it works, start there.
egi.outro_p2: If instead you have a question, a proposal, or something you want to understand before making a move, <contactlink>write to me</contactlink>.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.controller_body: Fabio Cherici, based in Florence, Italy. Email: fabio@florenceegi.com. This website fabiocherici.com is a personal site and does not collect data on its own servers.
privacy.data_collected_body: This site does not collect or store personal data. The contact form sends the entered data (name, email, message) directly as an email to the owner via an email delivery service (AWS SES). No data is saved to any database or web server.
privacy.purpose_body: Since no data is collected on servers, there is no automated processing. The only processing occurs if the user voluntarily decides to send an email through their own email client. In that case, processing is limited to direct email correspondence between the user and the controller.
privacy.legal_basis_body: Consent of the data subject (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) — expressed through explicit consent in the contact form before submission.
privacy.storage_body: The site does not store personal data on servers. Emails received via the contact form are stored in the owner's email inbox according to the email provider's retention policies. No additional copies or archives are made.
privacy.local_storage_body: The site uses the browser's localStorage to save user preferences: visual theme, accessibility settings, 3D scene, and animation style. This data is exclusively functional, is never transmitted to external servers, and can be deleted at any time from the browser settings. No cookies of any kind are used.
privacy.third_party_body: The site does not use analytics services (Google Analytics or similar), does not include tracking scripts, and does not load resources from external CDNs. Fonts are self-hosted. External links in the footer (GitHub, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Amazon) lead to third-party sites subject to their respective privacy policies.
privacy.rights_body: Under Articles 15-22 of the GDPR, the data subject has the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection. Since the site does not collect data, these rights apply exclusively to any emails voluntarily sent by the user.

epp.title: EPP
epp.subtitle: Environment Protection Programs
epp.hero_claim: 20% of every transaction on Florence EGI goes to the environment. This is not marketing. Not a promise. It is structural.
epp.hero_p1: When someone buys a certified work on the platform, twenty per cent of that transaction's value is automatically directed to environmental protection projects. Not at the end of the year, not at anyone's discretion: at the very moment of payment.
epp.hero_p2: I decided this would be the way Florence EGI exists in the world. Not as an add-on, not as a campaign — as part of the structure.
epp.split_alt: Pie chart showing the distribution of every transaction: 68% to the creator, 20% to the environment, 10% to the platform, 2% to Frangette APS.
epp.flow_title: The money never passes through us
epp.flow_p1: The buyer's payment is split directly by the payment processor — Stripe Connect — among the final recipients. Florence EGI never holds the funds, neither the creator's nor those destined for the environment.
epp.flow_p2: This is not a bank transfer we make at the end of the month. It is a split that happens the instant the payment is processed.
epp.flow_claim: Florence EGI never touches the funds. Direct split at the source.
epp.flow_traditional: Traditional model: Buyer → Company → The company decides → Maybe donates
epp.flow_alt: Flow diagram showing how the payment is split directly by the processor without passing through Florence EGI.
epp.not_intro: Three common confusions, cleared up once and for all.
epp.not_nft_desc: No financial trading. No speculation. EGIs are certificates of authenticity, not financial instruments.
epp.not_carbon_desc: No offsets. No CO₂ certificates. No calculated tonnage. Real revenue directed to real projects.
epp.not_sponsor_desc: It is not discretionary. Not revocable. Not an annual budget decision. It is part of the structure.
epp.not_yes_label: A structural share of real revenue directed to verifiable environmental projects
epp.not_alt: Visual comparison: what EPP is not (speculative NFT, carbon credit, sponsorship) and what it is (structural share of real revenue).
epp.guarantee_intro: Three independent levels prevent the mechanism from being altered.
epp.guarantee_code_desc: The distribution rule is written in the software. Changing it requires an intervention on the production code, tracked and verifiable.
epp.guarantee_corporate_desc: The 20% is part of the business model. It is not a budget to be renegotiated — it is a structural rule.
epp.guarantee_statutory_desc: Frangette APS — independent custodian. It oversees the allocation of the share. It cannot be overridden unilaterally.
epp.guarantee_alt: Three stacked guarantee levels: code, company, statute. The statutory level is highlighted.
epp.cycle_4: The organisation carries out the project
epp.cycle_caption: Every purchase funds the environment. Every project is traceable.
epp.cycle_alt: Circular diagram of the virtuous cycle: from the artist who creates to verifiable environmental impact.
epp.dashboard_title: What a partner organisation looks like
epp.dashboard_intro: Every partner organisation has a public profile on the platform: identity, active project, progress, amounts received. Visible to everyone, no registration required.
epp.dashboard_alt: Wireframe of a partner organisation profile on the Florence EGI platform with active project and amounts received.
epp.cta_p1: EPP is not a future project. It is active today. The mechanism is in production, the platform is operational, the infrastructure is ready to receive partner organisations.
epp.cta_p2: If you are an environmental organisation and want to understand how it works, <contactlink>let's talk</contactlink>. If you want to see the platform in action, <platformlink>enter here</platformlink>.

widgets.programs_section_intro: When a creator opens their collection, they choose which of the three programs will receive the 20% EPP share. The choice is permanent for each EGI and propagates to subsequent resales.
widgets.fiscal_section_intro: The EPP share allocated to environmental programs is an act of liberality: a donation, not a payment for services. The tax treatment depends on who you are. Florence EGI is not a withholding agent — it provides tracking and documentation tools, but compliance remains with you.

ragione_essere.title: Why I wanted this structure
ragione_essere.body_p1: Frangette was born to do something concrete to restore the ecosystem of planet Earth. Not to declare it. To do it.
ragione_essere.body_p2: I wanted to bring together two of humankind's most powerful driving forces: art and business. I have always been strongly motivated by these two areas of my life, and I thought — why not bring them together in a single effort to drive forward the urgent need to do something for the ecosystem?
ragione_essere.body_p3: We are not talking about climate change here. When we see Nobel laureates say one thing and other Nobel laureates say the exact opposite, figuring out where the truth lies is really complicated.
ragione_essere.body_p4: But the fact that we are destroying our forests, devastating our oceans and annihilating the pollinator population is plain to see. It is a common experience to feel deep outrage in front of scenes such as the plastic islands or a forest violated in its depths.
ragione_essere.body_p5: So I decided to use technology to find innovative solutions, and to generate money to be used in projects that take concrete action to remedy these scourges.
ragione_essere.body_p6: This is the nature of the Environment Protection Programs.

apr.title: APR
apr.subtitle: Aquatic Plastic Removal
apr.what_body: The APR program deals with the removal of plastic from water bodies. The creator who chooses APR for their collection automatically allocates the 20% EPP share (on primary sales) to projects for aquatic plastic removal, water cleaning, pre-sea interception, and coastal remediation.
apr.why_body: The Earth's oceans are facing a silent but devastating crisis. Every year millions of tonnes of plastic end up in seas and oceans, forming floating islands and infiltrating marine ecosystems at every level. It is not only a threat to marine fauna and flora: it has direct repercussions on human health and on the entire life cycle of the planet.
apr.continent_body: The "plastic islands" are huge masses of plastic waste concentrated at various points in the oceans, created by marine currents. The best known — the Great Pacific Garbage Patch — is a carpet of plastic debris whose surface is comparable to that of some countries. These islands are only the visible part: most of the plastic decomposes into smaller particles, invisible to the naked eye but no less dangerous.
apr.micro_body: Microplastics (fragments under 5 millimetres) and nanoplastics (even smaller) spread easily in the oceans, are ingested by marine fauna and, through the food chain, can reach us. The effects on human health are still being studied, but research suggests possible inflammation and toxicity at the cellular level.
apr.impact_body: Plastic pollution has direct repercussions on marine ecosystems: animals from plankton to large mammals ingest this waste, with fatal consequences. It disturbs the balance of ecosystems and impacts the economy of coastal communities that depend on fishing and tourism.
apr.status_text: program active in the creator's choice. Selection of partners in the field is in progress.

arf.title: ARF
arf.subtitle: Appropriate Restoration Forestry
arf.what_body: The ARF program deals with appropriate reforestation: right species for the territory, protection of young plantations, related biodiversity. The creator who chooses ARF allocates the 20% EPP share to projects for reforestation and the re-creation of forests and woodlands, respecting biodiversity and the natural habitat.
arf.scope_body: The program is not limited to Italy. Forests are lost everywhere, and ARF follows the projects where they are needed most.
arf.why_body: Deforestation is eroding the planet's green lung at an alarming rate. Every passing second we lose vital forest areas equivalent to the size of a football field.
arf.where_p1: In 2022, in the Amazon, the state of Amazonas in Brazil almost doubled its primary forest loss rate over three years. Most of the losses on the Brazilian side are due to large-scale clearing, probably for cattle pasture, along existing highways.
arf.where_p2: The Democratic Republic of the Congo continued to lose primary forest, over half a million hectares in 2022. There the main cause is small-scale agriculture and charcoal production.
arf.where_p3: Ghana recorded in the same year the highest percentage increase in primary forest loss — 18,000 hectares, many of them in protected areas.
arf.where_p4: Bolivia saw a record level of primary forest loss in 2022, with a 32% increase over 2021. There the main factor is commercial agriculture.
arf.status_text: program active in the creator's choice. Selection of partners in the field is in progress.

bpe.title: BPE
bpe.subtitle: Bee Population Enhancement
bpe.what_body: The BPE program deals with the protection and enhancement of the bee population: healthy colonies, restoration of flower meadows, research on native species. The creator who chooses BPE allocates the 20% EPP share to projects supporting pollinator populations.
bpe.name_body: The official name of the program is "Bee Population Enhancement" — enhancement of the population. Not protection, not education: enhancement.
bpe.why_body: Bees are among the most important pollinators on the planet, today under unprecedented threat. The rapid decline of their populations signals a profound environmental problem, with potentially disastrous impacts on biodiversity, agriculture and ecosystem balance.
bpe.depend_title: How much we depend on them
bpe.depend_body: About 70% of agricultural crops, providing 90% of the world's food, depend in some way on bees for pollination. Without these tireless workers, many foods we take for granted could become rare and expensive.
bpe.causes_body: The decline in bee populations is attributable to various factors: loss of habitat, excessive use of pesticides, climate change, diseases. Intensive agriculture, with its reliance on chemicals and the reduction of flowering areas, has drastically reduced food sources and nesting sites. Diseases such as colony collapse disorder (CCD) have further decimated populations.
bpe.impact_body: The decline of bees is not only an environmental issue, but also an economic one. Pollination is a vital ecosystem service that sustains agricultural production. Without it, many crops would not be able to produce fruit or seeds in sufficient quantities — reducing food availability and raising prices, hitting consumers and farmers alike.
bpe.status_text: program active in the creator's choice. Selection of partners in the field is in progress.

fiscalita_individuale.title: If you are an individual donor
fiscalita_individuale.subtitle: How the deduction works
fiscalita_individuale.disclaimer: This section refers to Italian tax law.
fiscalita_individuale.you_p1: When you purchase an EGI on the Florence EGI platform, 20% of the value of the transaction (on primary sales in the CONTRIBUTOR profile) is automatically allocated to the EPP program chosen by the creator. The split happens directly from the payment processor to the dedicated EPP wallet: Florence EGI never touches these funds.
fiscalita_individuale.you_p2: In Italian tax terms, the share allocated to an EPP is an act of liberality — a donation — not a payment for a service.
fiscalita_individuale.practice_item1: The EPP share is not subject to VAT (donations are not VAT operations).
fiscalita_individuale.practice_item2: Upon the donor's request, the receiving EPP entity issues a donation receipt.
fiscalita_individuale.practice_item3: The receipt is valid for tax deduction/deduction purposes pursuant to Art. 15 TUIR and to the regulations applicable to the receiving entity.
fiscalita_individuale.receipt_body: For users with a high volume of purchases, the FlorenceEGI dashboard allows you to request from the EPP entity a cumulative receipt — monthly or annual — downloadable directly, valid for tax deductions.
fiscalita_individuale.not_title: What Florence EGI does NOT do
fiscalita_individuale.not_p1: Florence EGI is not a withholding agent. It does not directly manage the tax documentation between you and the EPP entity. It provides the tools to track donations and request the receipt from the receiving entity, but the final responsibility for your tax declaration remains yours.
fiscalita_individuale.not_p2: For specific cases (large amounts, flat-rate regime, occasional services above threshold), it is recommended to consult your tax advisor.

fiscalita_aziende.title: If you are a company or large entity
fiscalita_aziende.subtitle: Integration and compliance
fiscalita_aziende.disclaimer: This section refers to Italian tax law.
fiscalita_aziende.intro_title: If you purchase EGI as a company
fiscalita_aziende.intro_body: When the buyer of an EGI is a legal person (S.p.A., S.r.l., structured association, foundation, NGO, public body), the 20% EPP share allocated to the environmental program remains an act of liberality, but the accounting and tax treatment follows the rules of your organisation.
fiscalita_aziende.vat_body: The EPP share is not subject to VAT. It is a donation, not a payment. Platform fees and any other components of the transaction instead follow the applicable VAT regime (Art. 22% ordinary unless exempt — see FlorenceEGI tax documentation for the cases of exemption of works of art pursuant to Art. 10 DPR 633/72).
fiscalita_aziende.books_body: The donation must be recorded in the accounting books according to your internal policy and the applicable accounting principles (OIC for Italian companies, IAS/IFRS for international groups). Deductibility depends on the legal nature of the receiving entity and on your own tax regime.
fiscalita_aziende.docs_intro: Florence EGI makes available to companies:
fiscalita_aziende.docs_item1: Export of transaction data in CSV or XML format
fiscalita_aziende.docs_item2: API webhooks for real-time notifications of donations
fiscalita_aziende.docs_item4: Complete on-chain audit trail of the allocated EPP shares
fiscalita_aziende.docs_outro: These tools facilitate integration with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle) or company CRMs, but do not replace the organisation's internal compliance procedure.
fiscalita_aziende.not_title: What Florence EGI does NOT do
fiscalita_aziende.not_p1: Florence EGI never acts as a withholding agent. It does not issue tax documentation in place of the recipient EPP entity, which remains responsible for issuing any receipts requested. Tax compliance always remains with the purchasing organisation and the receiving EPP entity.
fiscalita_aziende.not_p2: For complex cases (large amounts, multinational groups, donations that trigger specific CSR regulations or non-financial reporting), consult your tax advisor and internal compliance office.

fiscalita_epp.section_title: Are you an EPP receiving donations?
fiscalita_epp.section_intro: EPPs — Environmental Protection Projects — whether small non-profits or large companies and structured entities, receive funds directly from FlorenceEGI users through dedicated wallets linked to the collections. The platform offers advanced tools for reporting, automation and documentation support, but does not manage or hold the funds destined for the EPPs. Fiscal and administrative responsibility remains with the receiving entity, according to its legal nature.
fiscalita_epp.section_outro: FlorenceEGI never acts as a withholding agent and is not a party to the financial flows destined for the EPPs. Each EPP manages its own compliance: we provide only tools, traceability and transparency. All guidelines are made public in ToS, partner onboarding and technical documentation.

noprofit.title: Small non-profit entity (ETS / ONLUS)
noprofit.subtitle: Registered in the RUNTS or former ONLUS list, manages donations as acts of liberality pursuant to the Third Sector Code (D.Lgs. 117/2017).
noprofit.disclaimer: This section refers to Italian tax law.
how_items: Donations arrive directly on your account/wallet, without intermediation.
Donation receipts are issued only upon the donor's request (Italian regulation, not our choice).
Recommended mode: cumulative annual or monthly receipt for each donor, even in the case of thousands of micro-donations.
No electronic invoice: donations are acts of liberality, not payments.
The platform automatically generates pre-compiled receipts, digitally archived, downloadable by the donor from their dashboard.
All receipts are tracked for any tax audits (complete audit trail).
noprofit.example_body: The Frangette Association, which supports FlorenceEGI, operates this way: it receives donations directly on its own account, upon request issues cumulative receipts through the FlorenceEGI automatic system, all tracked according to ETS regulation.
noprofit.sources_body: D.Lgs. 117/2017 (Third Sector Code), Agenzia delle Entrate Circulars on ETS/ONLUS, RUNTS Regulation.

azienda.title: Large entity, company, structured group
azienda.subtitle: Organised entity with its own legal personality (SpA, Srl, foundation, NGO, multi-utility, corporate) which has internal accounting and administrative structures.
azienda.disclaimer: This section refers to Italian tax law.
how_items: Funds are transferred directly to an IBAN held by the entity or to a validated corporate wallet.

The production of receipts, donation attestations, credit notes takes place through your administrative office, according to your internal policies and the applicable accounting principles (OIC, IAS/IFRS).
FlorenceEGI offers API, downloadable reports, exportable audit trails to integrate data directly into your CRM, ERP systems, or your administrative flows.
Complete traceability of the flow in the platform, interoperability with your systems, reduction of manual workloads.
azienda.principle_body: The platform guarantees only traceability in the platform and data export. It does not replace your internal compliance procedures. You always remain responsible for the correct fiscal and administrative management of the funds received, according to your legal nature and your accounting regime.
azienda.example_body: A company receives 100,000€ for a project → downloads the transaction report → integrates the data with its own accounting/fiscal system → internally produces the documents required according to its own policies.
azienda.sources_body: Italian Civil Code, national and international accounting principles (OIC, IAS/IFRS), D.Lgs. 231/2007 (anti-money laundering), art. 83 D.Lgs. 117/2017.
